note: Exam elements must be performed sequentially according to voice prompts from the electronic system installed in the vehicle or instructions from the examiner. In case of conflicting instructions, examiner directives take priority.

disqualification.title: What fails you on the spot
disqualification.passRule: You start with 100 points and every mistake deducts penalty points. You pass if you collect no more than 39 penalty points (so you finish with at least 61) and you are not disqualified.
disqualification.intro: In any of these cases the exam stops immediately and counts as failed, whatever your score:
items: You collected more than 39 penalty points.
You created a dangerous situation, could not stop the car in time or lost control, so the examiner had to intervene or stop the exam.
You did not complete an exam element the required way.
By not performing an element or dragging it out, you held up the exam or got in the way of other candidates.
You broke the order of the elements, skipped an element or did not follow the examiner's lawful instruction.
In the "Dead End" you did not turn with the whole car inside the marked area, or did not finish on the left side, parallel to the start, fully leaving the area.
On the "Hill" you went more than 1 metre past the "STOP" line without stopping.
On the "Hill" the car rolled back more than 20 cm and you did not pull the handbrake immediately.
Jerky (non-smooth) driving was recorded for the third time.
You showed a low level of driving skill throughout the exam.
disqualification.source: Source: Driving licence exam rules, Articles 34 and 39 (matsne.gov.ge)

elements.title: A) "Parallel Parking"
elements.intro: When executing this element, the following requirements must be observed:

items.text: When entering the parking area, the vehicle must not cross the outer, front, or right boundary lines and poles.
When exiting the parking area, the vehicle must not cross or hit the markings and poles.
After stopping in the parallel parking area, the vehicle must be positioned entirely within the inner perimeter of the bounded space.
After completing the parking maneuver, the handbrake must be applied before exiting the space.

elements.title: B) "Zigzag" (Slalom)
elements.intro: When executing this element, the following requirements must be observed:

items.text: The maneuver must begin by passing the first center marking (pole) on its left side.
The vehicle must weave in a zigzag pattern between the central markings (poles).
Movement through the zigzag must be executed without crossing or hitting the boundaries (markings).
Forward motion in the intended direction must not stop (cease) from start to finish.
items.points: 10 penalty points; 15 if the engine stalls

items.text: Reversing during this element is strictly prohibited.

elements.title: C) Dead End / Turnaround ("Change of Direction")
elements.intro: When executing this element, the following requirements must be observed:

items.text: The maneuver must begin from the front-right side.
Forward movement must be performed using a single gear shift.
Reverse movement must be performed using a single gear shift.
The element must be completed without crossing or hitting boundary lines/markings.
The turn must be made so that the car's outer contour stays entirely inside the marked area.
The element must end on the left side, parallel to the starting side, with the car fully leaving the marked area.

elements.title: D) "Garage" (Reverse Bay Parking)
elements.intro: When executing this element, the following requirements must be observed:

items.text: After shifting into reverse gear, the vehicle must not roll forward/backward more than 30 cm.
Reversing into the garage must be completed in a single continuous attempt (single shift into reverse).
After stopping in the garage, the vehicle must be completely inside the designated area. Exiting the garage is permitted only after the vehicle is entirely within the garage boundaries.
Crossing the boundary lines in the garage.

elements.title: E) "Figure 8"
elements.intro: When executing this element, the following requirements must be observed:

items.text: Begin movement from the right side.
Exiting from the wrong side or taking a short loop/circle.
Stopping during the maneuver.
items.points: 5 penalty points; 15 if the engine stalls

items.text: Crossing lines or hitting outer boundary markers/barriers.
Reversing inside the Figure 8.

elements.title: F) "Uphill Ramp" ("Hill Start")
elements.intro: When executing this element, the following requirements must be observed:

items.text: The vehicle must stop at the "STOP" line on the slope (no further than 1 meter before the line).
items.points: 20 penalty points if the line is crossed or stopped more than 1 meter away

items.text: When moving off from the "STOP" line, the vehicle must not roll back more than 20 cm.

general.title: General Driving Requirements During the Exam

items.text: The applicant must not stall the engine from the start of the exam to its completion.
The seatbelt must be fastened from start to finish.
The vehicle must not be driven with the handbrake engaged.
The vehicle must not roll uncontrolled at any point during the exam.
The handbrake must not be used during the exam, except for Parallel Parking and the Hill Start elements.
The candidate must complete all designated exam elements.
If traffic lights are present on the testing ground, the candidate must obey their signals.
The vehicle must move smoothly (without jerking or sputtering) throughout the entire exam.
